title: More - Settings & Bank (Wayfinding)
prompt: iPhone 393x852 dark OLED screen for a NYS real estate salesperson exam study app, design system "NY RE Exam v2 Wayfinding": canvas #090d16, cards #111725 radius 18, controls #182033 radius 14, primary green #10b981, red #ef4444 only for destructive, Helvetica Neue bold sentence-case headings, system UI body, no all-caps labels, no arrows on buttons, no middle-dot separators. Topics are shown as NYC subway route bullets: small colored circles with a bold 1-character code (red 1, blue A, orange B, yellow Q, green 4) always next to the topic name. Floating translucent glass capsule tab bar at the bottom inset 12px with 5 tabs (Home, Build, Stats, Mistakes, More), active tab has a small green pill. Compact 28px large-title header at top. Screen: "More" tab active, settings page. Header title "More". Section 1 card "Install on iPhone": three numbered steps with small iOS glyphs (1 Open in Safari, 2 tap Share, 3 Add to Home Screen) and a note that it works offline after the first load. Section 2 "Your data" as an iOS grouped list inside one card: rows "Export study history", "Import study history", "Import question batch" each with a leading icon and 52px tall, a small secondary caption under the group describing the JSON batch format; then a separate quiet row "Reset all progress" in red text (no filled red button). Section 3 "Question bank" with total count on the right, a list of topics each with route bullet, topic name, and count right-aligned in tabular numbers. Section 4 small disclaimer text in secondary color. Bottom padding for the floating tab bar.
